scripts.preinstall: sh -c 'rm -f package-lock.json yarn.lock; case "$npm_config_user_agent" in pnpm/*) ;; *) echo "Use pnpm instead" >&2; exit 1 ;; esac'
scripts.build: pnpm run typecheck && pnpm -r --if-present run build
scripts.typecheck: pnpm run typecheck:libs && pnpm -r --filter "./artifacts/**" --filter "./scripts" --if-present run typecheck
scripts.test:unit:report: bash -c 'mkdir -p test-results; pnpm run test:unit; rc=$?; pnpm --filter @workspace/scripts run print-test-report -- unit.xml; exit $rc'
scripts.test:api:report: bash -c 'mkdir -p test-results; pnpm run test:api; rc=$?; pnpm --filter @workspace/scripts run print-test-report -- api.xml; exit $rc'
scripts.format:check:
prettier --check . || (printf '
[Format check failed] One or more files are not formatted correctly.
Run: pnpm run lint:fix

' >&2 && exit 1)
scripts.codegen:check:
pnpm --filter @workspace/api-spec run codegen && git --no-optional-locks diff --exit-code -- lib/api-client-react/src/generated/ lib/api-zod/src/generated/ artifacts/mockup-sandbox/src/.generated/ || (printf '
[codegen:check failed] Generated files differ from Orval output. Run: pnpm --filter @workspace/api-spec run codegen

' >&2 && exit 1)
scripts.dev:test: pnpm run dev:doctor && pnpm run dev:db:up && DATABASE_URL=${DATABASE_URL:-postgres://postgres:postgres@localhost:5432/rentrail} pnpm run dev:verify
